concept.material: dark walnut burl and brushed gunmetal plating
concept.internal_detail: bronze worm drives and miniature geared rocker arms
concept.button: a flush square gunmetal actuator inlaid with crosshatched knurling
concept.shell_mechanic: The gunmetal upper slab swings upward on a transversal rear pin while the lower walnut casing unfolds sideways
concept.emerging_parts: A blunt chisel-toothed head, two folded jointed forelegs, and a broad cross-hatched paddle tail
concept.signature_move: its flattened tail hinge ratchets upward two notches and strikes down flat against the palm with a dull metal tap
concept.turkish: Kuzey Amerika kunduzu (yassı kuyruklu, kemirgen yarı sucul memeli) — geniş spatula biçimli plaka, koyu ceviz ağacı yumrusu ve fırçalanmış tunç kaplama
